settings.intro_highlight: The Visiderm skin analysis station provides an optimized diagnostic foundation for advanced skincare environments by balancing practitioner ergonomics with premium Canadian manufacturing standards.
settings.custom_description: The Visiderm is engineered to elevate early-stage client consultations through highly precise structural skin analysis. Featuring a specialized 3 diopter optical magnification lens and powered by six synchronized neon tubes, this compact powerhouse delivers shadow-free, crystal-clear illumination across the entire facial landscape. It enables advanced skincare providers to identify deep-seated dermal irregularities, structural sun damage, and localized hydration imbalances before they become visible to the naked eye.
settings.subtitle: Advanced Optical Diagnostics for Premium Salons
settings.secondary_description: Positive attribute construction is central to the Equipro approach. To preserve the optical clarity and professional aesthetics of Visiderm, routine maintenance action with mild cleaning agents formulated for clinical environments should be performed after every consultation. The outer surface boasts superior scratch resistance property, ensuring an pristine condition outcome across a multi-year operational timeframe. Consistent care guarantees long-term service consistency and enhanced client comfort.

settings.question: Professional Applications:
settings.answer: Enables practicing estheticians to perform structured dermal evaluations, identifying subsurface hydration loss, sebum buildup, and pigmentation irregularities during initial consultations.

settings.question: Clinic Spa Therapist:
settings.answer: Delivers shadow-free 3-diopter optical magnification and 6 synchronized neon tubes for precise diagnostic clarity during clinical skin treatments and facial prep.

settings.question: Cosmetic Injector:
settings.answer: Allows clear visualization of skin texture and structural vascularity prior to advanced cosmetic and facial rejuvenation procedures.

settings.heading: Key Features for the Professional Station

settings.text: Secure the Visiderm on a stable workstation or mount it directly onto an approved Equipro deluxe column via the proper adapter bracket.
Plug the unit into an approved wall outlet or a designated 6-outlet master power bar, confirming the localized line voltage.
Direct the client to place their face comfortably within the specialized viewing enclosure, ensuring a complete seal against ambient room light.
Activate the integrated power switch to initialize all six diagnostic neon tubes simultaneously.
Observe the target area through the high-grade 3 diopter magnification viewing pane to analyze the subsurface structures.
The equipment must be kept in a completely dry, climate-controlled indoor environment at all times to avoid electrical oxidation.
All structural repairs or technical modifications must be performed exclusively by certified Equipro technicians to prevent voiding the factory warranty.
Do not spray liquid sanitizers directly into the internal light ballasts or onto the exposed electrical circuitry during room turnaround.

settings.question: How do I clean and maintain the optical system?
settings.answer: Wipe optical components with non-abrasive lens cleaning cloths and mild cleaning agents formulated for clinical optical equipment.

settings.question: Can the internal illumination tubes be replaced by the user?
settings.answer: Replacement neon tubes are available as replacement parts and can be swapped following the manufacturer guide.

settings.question: What is the warranty coverage for the Visiderm?
settings.answer: The Visiderm includes a 1-Year Manufacturer Warranty covering parts and labor.

settings.question: Are the electrical components safe for clinical use?
settings.answer: Yes, all internal electrical components are ETL approved and CSA & UL compliant for commercial clinical standards.

settings.question: What is the return policy for this equipment?
settings.answer: Equipment returns are subject to Equipro commercial distributor policies and warranty terms.
